title: packet-mq: Improve MQINQ Display
description:
Improve the display of MQINQ Segment, by adding dec/hex/Name
of selector in MQINQ/MQINQ_REPLY and trying to display
dec/hex/Name value of Integer Value when possible in MQINQ_REPLY

```
Before
MQINQ/MQSET
    Selector count..: 5
    Integer count...: 4
    Character length: 96
    Selector........: MQIA_COMMAND_LEVEL (31)
    Selector........: MQIA_PLATFORM (32)
    Selector........: MQIA_CODED_CHAR_SET_ID (2)
    Selector........: MQCA_Q_MGR_NAME (2015)
    Selector........: MQCA_Q_MGR_IDENTIFIER (2032)
    Integer value...: 920
    Integer value...: 11
    Integer value...: 850
    Integer value...: 0
    Char values.....: MQL1                                            MQL1_2020-11-19_08.42.51                        

After
MQINQ/MQSET
    Selector count..: 5
    Integer count...: 4
    Character length: 96
    Selector........: 0x0000001f (31) MQIA_COMMAND_LEVEL
    Selector........: 0x00000020 (32) MQIA_PLATFORM
    Selector........: 0x00000002 (2) MQIA_CODED_CHAR_SET_ID
    Selector........: 0x000007df (2015) MQCA_Q_MGR_NAME
    Selector........: 0x000007f0 (2032) MQCA_Q_MGR_IDENTIFIER
    Integer value...: 920
    Integer value...: 0x0000000b (11) MQPL_WINDOWS_NT
    Integer value...: 850
    Integer value...: 0
    Char values.....: MQL1                                            MQL1_2020-11-19_08.42.51                        

```

Just changing BASE_DEC to BASE_DEC_HEX or BASE_HEX_DEC for the hfs would give you both the hexadecimal and decimal representation. If that's the main enhancement.
Not sure if I'm that fond of the new output - but no strong opinion.

+1 use BASE_DEC_HEX

and not fan of about change for align
Don't like it either. As said this is where BASE_DEC_HEX and BASE_HEX_DEC was introduced for, to keep consistent representations among protocols.

Hi,
tried with
 
```
'BASE_HEX_DEC, NULL' --> 'Selector........: 0x0000001f (31)'
'BASE_DEC_HEX, NULL' --> 'Selector........: 31 (0x0000001f)'
'BASE_HEX_DEC | BASE_EXT_STRING, GET_VALS_EXTP(selector)' --> 'Selector........: MQIA_COMMAND_LEVEL (0x0000001f)'
 missing DEC Value (or Hex value if it is BASE_DEC_HEX)
```
The main enhancement is to have 'HEX (DEC) TEXT' value aligned

What I will do is display 'HEX (DEC) TEXT' as expected for BASE_HEX_DEC with no align on the DEC and the text at the end

I've also adapted all other Int display having this sort of display -> 0x........ (##) @@@@

before for PCF List
`--> MQPrm[ 7] { 3-INTEGER        }       20/   32-MQIA_PLATFORM                         b-(       11) MQPL_WINDOWS_NT`
after  for PCF List
`--> MQPrm[ 7] { 3-INTEGER        }       20/   32-MQIA_PLATFORM                  0x0000000b (11) MQPL_WINDOWS_NT`

Robert

HEX (DEC) String

I will then use the BASE_HEX_DEC once it will work with the BASE_EXT_STRING, so please can you continue to check and merge this change, because the improvement is real

Hi, Please don't get hung up on 'it's stupid' I think it's a language thing :-) Just trying to say that most dissectors do not try to align things and it may not be worth the effort trying to do it as it may be diffucult to find a good representation. Could you please update the Before/after display above to the current status? Looking at the included text files I think both representations have their flaws. 
     MQPrm[77] {4-STRING} 803/2051-MQCA_SSL_CRYPTO_HARDWARE 
     MQPrm[78] {3-INTEGER} 4b/75-MQIA_SSL_EVENT 0x00000000 (0) MQEVR_DISABLED
     MQPrm[79] {3-INTEGER} 5c/92-MQIA_SSL_FIPS_REQUIRED 0x00000000 (0) MQSSL_FIPS_NO

     MQPrm[77] { 4-STRING         }      803/ 2051-MQCA_SSL_CRYPTO_HARDWARE       
     MQPrm[78] { 3-INTEGER        }       4b/   75-MQIA_SSL_EVENT                        0-(        0) MQEVR_DISABLED
     MQPrm[79] { 3-INTEGER        }       5c/   92-MQIA_SSL_FIPS_REQUIRED                0-(        0) MQSSL_FIPS_NO
Personally I'm not to fond of the many spaces inside the brackets, and I think I'd prefere 0x before hexadecimal numbers. Unfortunatly we do not have any APIs to make tables. This said I do not have a strong opinion on this patch. Regards Anders

Thanks and ok for the "it's stupid"

I've adapted the description with new layout and added a new 'aligned' file (with current output value for Integer Value) 

I will later, look to adapt and reduce the space between brackets and adapt display of hex value prefixed with 0x..
